description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetCommentAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing comments on timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods to update, retrieve, and validate timesheet comments, utilizing traits and service dependencies for business logic and data access.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating comments on timesheet entries, handling validation, permission checks, and data persistence.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update or create a comment for a specific timesheet entry based on provided parameters, performing validation and saving changes.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific timesheet comment, verifying permissions and existence.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation, including required fields and data formats.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single comment, ensuring necessary identifiers are provided.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises exception if called.

methods.name: checkAuthorityAccessible
methods.description: Ensures the user has access rights to the specified timesheet before proceeding.

methods.name: setCommentToTimesheetItem
methods.description: Assigns the comment from request parameters to the TimesheetItem entity.
